### What was reported

The fictional Larkfield village bakery moved shaping from 04:00 to the previous afternoon and baked from loaves held overnight in a cold proof. The owner reported a more even crumb and a calmer morning shift.

### Reading it critically

The account is written by the bakery itself and reports no measurements. The more even crumb could come from the longer cold proof or from shaping by daylight with a rested team. Either way, the change moved a waiting step to where a delay costs little, which is the idea in the [oven module](#/module/hearth-m03).

### What you can transfer

Plan the step that can stretch, as the [fermentation module](#/module/hearth-m01) explains, and keep the evidence that ends each wait.
